## Case studies

## Interpretation and limitations

*Explain observed differences and failure modes. Report sample counts and
variation across repeated trials before drawing model-level conclusions.*

The snapshot preserves run IDs in `provenance.json`, individual results in
`runs.csv`, and grouped results in `comparison.csv`. It includes recorded runs
only; tasks that terminated before logging are not represented. Historical runs
may lack artifacts or metrics. Current runs preserve generation and iteration
histories as well as final traces, judge feedback, and the final animation.
